prompt: You model a user profile whose name, email, and age are updated independently. Which structure fits best?
explanation: A hash stores field-value pairs, so HSET and HGET touch one field at a time without rewriting the whole object. A concatenated string would force a read-modify-write of the entire value for every field update.

options.text: A hash with one field per attribute
One string key per user holding all attributes concatenated
A set containing the attribute names
A list holding the attribute values in order
